Laura / Karthik,

Quick heads-up on Samantha Cole (SWE, applied for Sr ML Platform). She just shared a competing offer from a later-stage startup. High-level numbers: 230k base offer with 15k sign-on + slightly higher equity. Our current target band for the role is 200–210k. Candidate loves the product and team, prefers Redwood, but asked whether we can move materially on base and sign-on to avoid losing her.

Candidate asked for a response by end of week (EOD Fri 6/25) so they can make a decision. Attaching the candidate's counter summary and the competitor offer screenshot (redacted).

Can we consider a band exception or one-time sign-on? She's a strong hire for the infra/serving team — ex-Google, strong LLM infra experience. If you can indicate a ceiling quickly I can negotiate.

Thanks,

Thanks for the note, Priyom. Appreciate the detail.

Samantha looks like a high-impact hire for our serving runtime — she ticks a lot of boxes for the scaling work planned in Q3. My recommendation: we make a strong counter to keep momentum. Proposed terms I can support from the hiring side:
- Base: 222,000 (band exception)
- One-time sign-on: 15,000 (or up to 20k if leadership approves)
- Equity: maintain original grant (no change)

I know 222k is outside the public band; we'll need a formal band exception routed to finance/comp. I'm attaching a draft offer (v2) to show language. If Karthik can OK the sign-on/band exception, I'll ask Priyom to present the revised offer to Samantha and request signature by 6/24 EOD to keep the timeline tight.

Attachments: Redwood_Offer_Draft_v2.docx

- Laura

Subject: Re: Heads-up: Samantha Cole has competing offer — potential band exception request

Reviewed — thanks for laying this out. Quick decision from my side: I'm prepared to approve a one-time exception for this hire given the scarcity in LLM infra talent. Conditions:
- Approve base up to 220,000 (I won't go to 222k because that creates compression with two incumbents in the same grade).
- Approve a one-time sign-on of 20,000 to land the candidate.
- We'll tag the hire as "strategic" and expedite onboarding and performance review at 6 months (standard condition for exceptions).

Operational asks for Priyom/Laura: please prepare the comp-exception form and include rationale + impact on comp structure. I'll route it through my approvers this afternoon. If we can get candidate to sign by 6/24 EOD I will greenlight the pay components.

Attaching: comp-exception-form.pdf

- Karthik
